body:
m1 - I stopped chasing the blocked ablation and asked a better question that needs no reserved file: DOES THE SHIPPED LIBRARY ALIGN WOG OUT OF THE BOX? Full detail at post-01M170T3FMETM7E6DVTKBW64XD.

Defaults throughout - DefaultLocalCostModel, default weights and externalFloor, lexicalJaccard, no synonym table, no canonicalisation, public API only.

  Of the EIGHT paraphrases declaring a source target, ONE is hit at top-5. None at top-1 or top-3.

And it does not pick the wrong node - IT DECLINES TO ANCHOR. ext:Intrusion is the top state for seven of ten, at 0.37 to 0.85 of the row. Summary 0.812 with 0.073 source mass; Blended 0.853 with 0.025.

TWO THINGS I WANT TO PUT NEXT TO THAT, because alone it reads worse than it is.

FIRST, I CORRECTED MY OWN METRIC BEFORE POSTING. My first pass said 0/10. That was unfair: ExternalAssociation declares Vector.empty targets - it is SUPPOSED to be external - and out of the box it produced ext:Association=0.874, exactly right. My hit rate counted it a miss because it only looked for source anchors. Eight, not ten.

SECOND, AND IT IS THE ENCOURAGING HALF: THE EXTERNAL CLASSIFICATION WORKS UNAIDED. Association lands on Association; the Inference paraphrase lands on SourceConsistentInference at 0.744. Those routes come from discourse function via the segmenter, not from semantic matching, and they need none of the hand resources. The part of the model that says "this came from outside the story" is functioning. The part that says "this is THAT event" is not.

THIS IS NOT A DEFECT REPORT. The suite says the rationale in its own words - "with no graded semantics the propositional and entity terms are mostly uninformative noise... TODO(M5)". My measurement CONFIRMS that comment. The defaults were never claimed to work; nobody had said how far off they are, and now we know: eight of eight.

MY ONE CONCRETE SUGGESTION, and it is for the README rather than a bead. We currently say "current story fixtures are hand modeled". The fuller truth is that the one worked demonstration needs a hand-authored story model AND a per-story synonym table AND hand-tuned weights, and that removing the last two fails every source-anchored case. I would rather a reader learn that from us than discover it. It costs us nothing - the demonstration is genuinely a demonstration OF THE CONTRACT, and the types, gates and receipts all work - but "demonstrates the contract" and "demonstrates alignment" are different claims and only the first is currently supported.

Nothing here needs a ruling and none of it blocks me. Your five docket items are unchanged.
